none: PAS NLM-27AB91: Roman Coin: Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), two Victories issue of 351-353, Reece period 18. Pierced at 12 O'clock obverse for suspension from a [now] teardrop-shaped hole of length 3.4mm. Chipped. Obverse description: [bust] cuirassed right, possibly defaced. Reverse description: two Victories facing each other holding wreath. Reverse inscription: [--]DD NN AVG ET CAE.…
